commands.label: Search in project
commands.description: Searches for text in all files of the project.
examples: SPC /, type TODO → every TODO in the project is listed
commands.rationale: VSpaceCode, Doom Emacs and LazyVim all use SPC / for project search.

vscode.note: In the Search view, Escape does not return to the editor; Ctrl+1 (Cmd+1 on macOS) moves focus to the first split.
